conditions.completion: matching UI and controls plus draw submission followed by requestAnimationFrame
conditions.tap: trusted pointer event timestamps; primary release-to-presentation; full gesture also recorded
conditions.radio_tcp_tls_cdn: not modeled by the HTTP/1.1 replay; live HTTPS delivery probes reported separately
conditions.state: optimized x86_64 disposable authority, fresh roots per case; no live state edits

public_delivery.method: sequential frame-to-public HTTPS Wasm reads; separate from replay, no mobile timing claim
